description: County Health Rankings & Roadmaps publishes yearly county-level measures of health outcomes and the factors that shape them for every county in the United States, run by the University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute. The analytic data combine many public sources into measures such as premature death, uninsured rates, ratios of population to primary care physicians, dentists and mental health providers, preventable hospital stays, housing problems, broadband access, income and education. The data and documentation page offers the 2025 national analytic data as CSV and SAS files with a data dictionary and technical documentation, a supplemental release of March 2026, and earlier years for trends. Files are free to download without an account, though the site footer states all rights reserved and no open licence is given, so reuse terms should be checked. Caveats: measures come from sources of different years, county values for small populations are unstable, and the ranking model changed in recent releases. Simulation uses: adding health access and social vulnerability layers to hazard exposure and equity analyses, and weighting counties in healthcare resilience studies. Related records: the HRSA shortage areas (data-hrsa-shortage-areas-hpsa-mua) and the Area Deprivation Index (data-neighborhood-atlas-area-deprivation-index) cover related aspects.
